description: Start background extraction of one local file; return task_id after upload confirmation without waiting for processing or exporting results. This confirms submission, not successful extraction. Use wait_for_task_extraction, then fetch_document_result for a returned document ID or download_results to save an export; get_task_results can inspect partial documents. Uploads may consume credits. On timeout, use any returned recovery task_id rather than uploading again. auto_approve defaults true; false requests human review, which MCP cannot perform or approve. The returned auto_approve echoes the requested option, not backend approval status.

auto_approve.description: Automatically approve extracted documents. Defaults to true. Set false only when human review is requested; use a start-only extraction tool to retain the task ID. MCP cannot approve documents, and combined extraction may time out while review is pending.

file_path.description: Path to a local document on the machine running this MCP server, not a URL or chat attachment. Supported extensions: .pdf, .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .heic, .heif. Prefer an absolute path; relative paths use the server's working directory and ~ is not expanded.

folder_id.description: Optional remote Suparse folder ID to assign to uploaded documents.

pdf_password.description: Optional password for an encrypted PDF. Treat this as a secret; it is used only for the upload and is not returned in results.

split.description: Enable auto-splitting of multi-page documents with mixed document types.

template_id.description: Optional extraction template ID. Use only a non-system team template ID from list_templates. System template IDs are discovery-only and cannot be passed directly. Omit to let Suparse auto-detect, or use an authorized quick-schema workflow to create a team template.

name: start_file_extraction
title: Start File Extraction
